channel.title: Farrelly Atkinson Limited - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Farrelly Atkinson Limited (road.cc)

item.title: “Entitled” driver moans about “extremely irritating” children cycling to school “chatting” and taking up “whole road”; Endura launches ‘Don’t be a helmet. Wear one’ campaign… with fake crash; NSN’s Barca kit; Mini G; Hideous Ineos? + more on the live blog
item.description: Still drying off from your stormy morning commute? Don’t worry, Ryan Mallon’s here to brighten up your day (kind of) with all the latest cycling news, views, and silliness on the wet and windy Tuesday live blog

item.title: British Cycling brings in corporate finance consultants and creates new events wing to "supercharge commercial growth" amid declining membership figures
item.description: British Cycling says separating their commercial businesses into a new entity can "grow events and new digital revenue streams"

item.title: Seven people arrested after counterfeit Specialized manufacturers busted in Chinese police raid
item.description: Chinese tech giant Alibaba say the seizure of fraudulent goods was the largest anti-counterfeit measure in Specialized's history, with over £1 million worth of goods seized

item.title: Specialized Tarmac SL8 Comp
item.description: A good race bike that is begging for a few upgrades 7/10

item.title: Prendas Ciclismo owner returns to profit and "proud to have stabilised" despite heavy bike industry downturn
item.description: Cycling Brands Ltd, which also owns custom-clothing maker Shutt Velo Rapide, said they "are not complacent" despite the upturn in fortunes.

item.title: Selle Italia SLR 3D Carbon
item.description: Super-light, super-pricey and deeply gorgeous – pair it with the right shorts and the comfort's good too 7/10

item.title: World’s fastest descender hits 65mph on bike… in the dark, complete with terrifying speed wobble; Red Bull riders tow plane to take-off; Pogačar snubbed (again) by BBC SPOTY; Movistar pro’s bizarre teacup injury; Picnic problems + more on the live blog
item.description: It’s Wednesday, it’s still windy, and Ryan Mallon’s back, one eye on Friday afternoon, with all the latest cycling news, views, and nonsense on the midweek live blog. Is it Christmas yet?

item.title: Government must “move from good intentions to a clear long-term plan” for cycling, campaigners warn, as £626 million active travel investment announced
item.description: British Cycling and Cycling UK are among the signatories calling for "predictable cycles and transparent reporting" of infrastructure investment

item.title: “These bikes get hammered, and they have the scars to prove it”: Tern's cargo fleet hits million-mile milestone in New York, claiming its bikes can match vans for delivery speed and volume
item.description: Research into the effectiveness of Tern’s cargo bikes in the Big Apple point to big cost savings with no effect on efficiency compared to vans, plus environmental benefits such as better traffic flow on busy city streets

item.title: MotoGP World Champion has custom Pinarello stolen by thief dressed as team mechanic
item.description: The customised €20,000 Dogma F was stolen during the Valencia Grand Prix weekend, but Spanish Police returned the bike and have arrested a suspect
